items.source:
Combine the request conditions held by the two RequestConditionHolder
instances after making sure the conditions are of the same type.
items.translation: 在确保条件类型相同后，合并两个 RequestConditionHolder 实例所持有的请求条件。

items.source: Uses of RequestConditionHolder in org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.condition
A holder for a RequestCondition useful when the type of the request condition is not known ahead of time, for example, custom condition.
items.translation: 用于 `RequestCondition` 的持有器，在请求条件的类型无法预先确定时非常有用，例如自定义条件。

items.source: Common MVC logic for matching incoming requests based on conditions.
items.translation: 用于根据条件匹配传入请求的通用 MVC 逻辑。

items.source:
Get the matching condition for the held request condition wrap it in a
new RequestConditionHolder instance.
items.translation: 获取已持有请求条件的匹配条件，并将其封装在一个新的 `RequestConditionHolder` 实例中。

items.source:
Compare the request conditions held by the two RequestConditionHolder
instances after making sure the conditions are of the same type.
items.translation: 在确保条件类型相同后，比较两个 RequestConditionHolder 实例所持有的请求条件。
